loader.summary:
CARLA_GaussianLSS uses a two-stage pipeline. (A) GENERATION (offline): GaussianLSS/data/carla_dataset.py::CarlaDataset reads a nuScenes-format CARLA DB via the NuScenes devkit, renders the BEV vehicle mask + visibility + aux, and SaveDataTransform (transforms.py:46) writes per-frame PNG/NPZ plus the scene_*.json. (B) TRAINING/EVAL (the path that consumes the jsons at /NHNHOME/.../carla_geobev_labels/gaussianlss/{sedan,suv,bus}/scene_*.json): GaussianLSS/data/carla_dataset_generated.py::CarlaGeneratedDataset (line 50) loads one json per scene (json.loads of f'{scene_name}.json', line 52). Each json is a list of frame dicts; __getitem__ wraps the dict in Sample(**dict) and applies LoadDataTransform (transforms.py:100). get_data() (line 13) builds one dataset per scene name returned by get_split(split,'carla'); data_module.py ConcatDatasets them. dataset_dir + labels_dir are injected by Hydra (carla.yaml has them as ???; dataset_dir = carla_geobev image root, labels_dir = the gaussianlss/{vehicle} label dir).

The actual on-disk frame dict has keys: images[6] (relative jpg under dataset_dir, e.g. 'sweeps/RGB-CAM_FRONT_LEFT/SimBEV-scene-0000-frame-0000-RGB-subcompact__CAM_FRONT_LEFT.jpg'), intrinsics[6] (3x3, source 1600x900: fx=fy=953.40, cx=800, cy=450), extrinsics[6] (4x4), view (3x3), bev ('bev_<token>.png'), aux ('aux_<token>.npz'), visibility ('visibility_<token>.png'), ego_z (float), pose/pose_inverse (4x4), cam_ids[6], cam_channels[6], token, scene. (Note: extra keys ego_z, cam_ids, aux beyond the task's stated list.)

LoadDataTransform.get_cameras (transforms.py:143) builds image tensors + lidar2img; get_bev (line 215) loads the BEV/visibility/aux. The model (GaussianLSS.py:411,438) does img2lidars=lidar2img.inverse() to unproject pixel+depth into the ego/lidar-flat BEV frame, confirming lidar2img = K_4x4 @ E maps ego(lidarflat)->image, i.e. E (extrinsics) is ego2cam (cam_from_egolidarflat). Visibility>=2 filtering is NOT done in the dataset; the dataset always returns the full bev (200x200) and bev_visibility (200x200), and the >=2 mask is applied downstream in losses.py (BinarySegmentationLoss/Center/Offset, min_visibility=2) and metrics.py IoUMetric.update (line 66-70). The global config min_visibility=2 comes from config/experiment/GaussianLSS.yaml. So an mmdet3d port must EITHER carry bev_visibility and mask IoU/loss at eval, or it will diverge from their reported numbers.
key_facts: Loader class: GaussianLSS/data/carla_dataset_generated.py::CarlaGeneratedDataset (line 50). __getitem__ (line 59): data=Sample(**self.samples[j]); data=self.transform(data). Transform = LoadDataTransform (transforms.py:100).

json path resolution: CarlaGeneratedDataset.__init__ line 52: json.loads((Path(labels_dir)/f'{scene_name}.json').read_text()). labels_dir = .../carla_geobev_labels/gaussianlss/{sedan|suv|bus}. 220 scenes per vehicle. scene names from splits/carla/{train,val}.txt (e.g. 'scene_0001').

bev png resolution (transforms.py:215-223 get_bev): scene_dir = labels_dir/sample.scene; Image.open(scene_dir/sample.bev) where sample.bev='bev_<token>.png'. So bev png lives in labels_dir/scene_XXXX/bev_<token>.png (sibling dir to the json).

bev png format: mode 'I;16' (uint16), 200x200. Decoded via common.py decode(img, n=num_classes): x=(arr[...,None]>>shift)&1 with shift=arange(n). For num_classes=1, vehicle mask = (arr & 1). Then bev=(255*decoded).astype(uint8) then to_tensor -> float in [0,1], shape (1,200,200).

Multi-class bit-packing: encode (common.py:49) packs channels as sum(bit<<channel). On disk values include 0,3,16,19,32,512,1027 (multi-layer), but with num_classes=1 only bit0 (vehicle) is decoded; verified ch0 vehicle px=3212/40000.

vehicle channel meaning: GT_SEG_CHANNELS['vehicle']=[1,2,3,4] (car/truck/bus/motorcycle) in carla_dataset.py:15. At generation these 4 GT_SEG channels are OR'd into the single 'vehicle' layer (load_bev_from_gt_seg line 224-227), then AND'd with rasterized 3D-bbox masks (render_bev_from_boxes line 266), then ego footprint zeroed (line 274).

view matrix (common.py:18 get_view_matrix, h=w=200, h_meters=w_meters=100): np.float32([[0,-sw,w/2],[-sh,0,h*offset+h/2],[0,0,1]]) with sh=sw=h/h_meters=2 px/m. On disk view=[[0,-2,100],[-2,0,100],[0,0,1]]. Maps ego XY(meters)->BEV pixel: u=-2*Y+100, v=-2*X+100 (0.5 m/cell, ego at pixel (100,100)).

extrinsics E (4x4) = cam_from_egocam @ egocam_from_world @ world_from_egolidarflat (carla_dataset.py:175) = ego(lidarflat)->camera (ego2cam). Confirmed by model img2lidars=lidar2img.inverse() (GaussianLSS.py:411).

lidar2img build (transforms.py:196-202): K_4x4=eye(4); K_4x4[:3,:3]=I (rescaled intrinsics); lidar2img = K_4x4 @ E. Stacked to (6,4,4). Output dict keys: 'image' (6,3,224,480), 'lidar2img' (6,4,4). intrinsics/extrinsics only emitted if split_intrin_extrin=True (False here).

image preprocessing (transforms.py:143-169): h_resize=h+top_crop=224+46=270, w_resize=480. image.resize((480,270),BILINEAR) from source 1600x900, then crop((0,46,480,270)) -> final 224x480. NO ImageNet normalization: img_transform = ToTensor() only (augment='none', transforms.py:116-120) -> float [0,1].

intrinsic adjustment for resize+crop (transforms.py:162-167): I[0,0]*=w_resize/1600; I[0,2]*=w_resize/1600; I[1,1]*=h_resize/900; I[1,2]*=h_resize/900; then I[1,2]-=top_crop(46). Applied per-cam before K_4x4@E.

visibility png: mode 'L', 200x200, on-disk values {1,2,4,255} (255=bg/road default, set in get_visibility carla_dataset.py:318; per-annotation visibility_token rasterized into bbox). Loaded as np.array uint8 into result['bev_visibility'] (transforms.py:230-232).

visibility>=2 filter applied DOWNSTREAM (not in dataset): losses.py BinarySegmentationLoss/CenterLoss/OffsetLoss forward use vis_mask=visibility>=self.min_visibility (lines 27,102); metrics.py IoUMetric.update line 67: mask=batch['bev_visibility']>=min_visibility, then pred/target=[mask]. min_visibility=2 from config/experiment/GaussianLSS.yaml.

aux npz (transforms.py:234-239): np.load(scene_dir/sample.aux)['aux'], shape (200,200,8) float32. bev_center=aux[...,1] (->(1,200,200)); bev_offset=aux[...,2:4].permute(2,0,1) (->(2,200,200)). carla.yaml outputs: bev[0,1] center[1,2] offset[2,4] index aux channels.

top_crop=46, BEV 200x200=100mx100m=0.5 m/cell, extent +-50m. GT_SEG source is 360x360 @0.4 m/px (GT_SEG_SIZE=360, GT_SEG_RESOLUTION=0.4, center=180); crop to 250x250 px (100/0.4) then cv2.resize NEAREST to 200x200 (carla_dataset.py:217-233).

config (carla.yaml): dataset='carla_generated', classes=[vehicle], num_classes=1, image h=224 w=480 top_crop=46, bev h=w=200 h_meters=w_meters=100 offset=0.0, split_intrin_extrin=False, key='bev', outputs.bev=[0,1].
port_actions: Already at target spec (R50 must be substituted: GaussianLSS uses EfficientNet/timm backbone, but the dataset/GT path is backbone-agnostic). Image target IS 224x480 and BEV IS 200x200 (100m, 0.5 m/cell) per carla.yaml — no change to those dims.

In the mmdet3d dataset __getitem__: read scene_*.json with json.load; for each frame iterate the 6 entries. Resolve image = dataset_dir / images[i] (dataset_dir = carla_geobev root, the path that makes 'sweeps/RGB-CAM_*/...jpg' valid).

Image transform (replicate transforms.py:143-169 EXACTLY): PIL resize source(1600x900)->(480,270) BILINEAR, then crop (0,46,480,270) -> (224,480). For mmdet3d add ImageNet normalization ONLY if your R50 expects it (GaussianLSS does NOT normalize — it feeds ToTensor [0,1]); for an ImageNet-pretrained R50 you typically DO mean/std normalize, so apply mmdet3d Normalize(mean=[123.675,116.28,103.53],std=[58.395,57.12,57.375]). Document this as a deviation from GaussianLSS.

Intrinsic rescale per cam (transforms.py:162-167): I=float32(intrinsics[i]); I[0,0]*=480/1600; I[0,2]*=480/1600; I[1,1]*=270/900; I[1,2]*=270/900; I[1,2]-=46. Build lidar2img = pad(I to 4x4 with eye) @ E where E=extrinsics[i] (4x4, already ego2cam). Stack to (6,4,4). Provide as img_metas['lidar2img'] (mmdet3d convention: lidar2img projects ego/lidar pts -> image, matches K@E here).

GT vehicle mask (200x200): open labels_dir/scene/bev_<token>.png as 16-bit (PIL 'I;16' or cv2.imread(path, cv2.IMREAD_UNCHANGED)); vehicle = (uint16_arr & 1).astype(uint8). Shape (200,200). This is the gt_vehicle seg target. Ego XY->pixel uses view=[[0,-2,100],[-2,0,100],[0,0,1]] (u=-2Y+100, v=-2X+100).

Visibility mask for fair eval: open labels_dir/scene/visibility_<token>.png ('L', uint8, values {1,2,4,255}); build valid_mask = (vis>=2). Apply this mask when computing vehicle-occupancy IoU/loss (GaussianLSS uses min_visibility=2). Carry it as gt_bev_visibility in the data dict; do NOT pre-mask the bev png itself (their dataset returns full bev + separate visibility).

DO NOT use carla_dataset.py at runtime — it needs the NuScenes devkit DB and regenerates labels. Only carla_dataset_generated.py + transforms.py LoadDataTransform define the runtime contract you must mirror.

Frame fields you need from json per frame: images[6], intrinsics[6](3x3), extrinsics[6](4x4 ego2cam), view(3x3), bev(filename), visibility(filename), scene, token. aux/bev_center/bev_offset only needed if porting GaussianLSS center/offset heads (offset/center decoder) — for pure vehicle occupancy seg you can drop aux.

Split handling: read splits/carla/{train,val}.txt (one scene name per line, e.g. 'scene_0001'); the same split file is shared — per-vehicle separation (sedan/suv/bus) is by which labels_dir you point at. _eval label dirs (sedan_eval etc.) exist as separate eval sets.
gotchas: bev png is 16-bit bit-PACKED, not a plain 0/255 mask. PIL opens as mode 'I;16'; np.array gives uint16 with values like 3,16,19,512,1027 (multi-layer leftovers). Vehicle = bit0 = (arr & 1). Using cv2.imread without IMREAD_UNCHANGED or treating as 8-bit will corrupt the mask. num_classes=1 means ONLY bit0 is decoded as vehicle.
extrinsics E is ego2cam (cam_from_egolidarflat), NOT cam2ego. lidar2img=K@E. If you assume cam2ego you must invert. Verified by model using lidar2img.inverse() to go img->ego.

pose uses a YAW-ONLY flattened rotation (get_pose flat=True, common.py:38-40): world_from_egolidarflat drops pitch/roll. The BEV frame is gravity-aligned ego-flat, not full 6DoF ego. Relevant if you reconstruct world coords.

GaussianLSS applies NO ImageNet normalization (img_transform = ToTensor only, [0,1]). An ImageNet R50 port will need normalization added — this is a real numerical deviation to call out, not a free swap.

visibility>=2 filtering is in the LOSS and METRIC, not the dataset. The dataset emits the FULL bev (incl. low-visibility vehicles). If you bake vis>=2 into the GT mask at dataset time you'll change both training target and IoU denominator vs. their setup. Keep bev and visibility separate; mask only at metric/loss time with min_visibility=2.

Source camera res is 1600x900 (cx=800,cy=450), but the actual jpg on disk may be a different physical size — the intrinsic rescale uses image.width/image.height from the OPENED PIL image (transforms.py:163 uses image.width), NOT a hardcoded 1600. Verify the on-disk jpg dimensions; if jpgs are already 1600x900 the math matches, otherwise rescale by true opened size.

top_crop math: resize target height is h+top_crop=270 (=224+46), then top 46 rows cropped. I[1,2]-=46 AFTER the y-scale. Order matters; doing crop before scale or subtracting before scaling gives wrong principal point.

view matrix has sw/sh on the OFF-diagonal ([0,-sw] row0, [-sh,0] row1) — it both scales AND swaps/negates axes (ego X->-row, ego Y->-col). Don't assume an axis-aligned diagonal scale; the BEV image axes are rotated/flipped relative to ego XY.

json frame dict carries extra keys not in the task's stated list (ego_z, cam_ids, aux). Sample.__init__ requires token,scene,intrinsics,extrinsics,images,view,bev as named args and absorbs the rest via **kwargs — a strict mmdet3d schema must tolerate/ignore the extras.

__getitem__ has a forward-scan-on-OSError fallback (carla_dataset_generated.py:64-75): missing images are silently skipped to the next loadable index. A faithful eval-count port should instead error or log, else sample counts can silently differ.
aux is (200,200,8) float32; only channels 1 (center) and 2:4 (offset) are used. Channel 0 is unused by the loader (bev comes from the png, not aux). Do not confuse aux ch0 with the vehicle mask.

glue.summary:
GOAL: feed BEVFormer (R50, 224x480 imgs, 200x200 BEV, pc_range +-50m) a 200x200 binary vehicle-occupancy BEV mask as GT, with img_metas['lidar2img'] correct for point_sampling. Two viable GT sources exist and they DISAGREE on BEV axis layout, which is the crux.

(1) LIDAR2IMG. Main repo builds it in nuscenes_dataset.py:129-139 (CustomNuScenesDataset.get_data_info), seg repo identically in BEVFormer_segmentation_detection/.../nuscenes_dataset.py:231-241. Both consume the nuScenes-DB-format cam_info keys sensor2lidar_rotation (3x3) and sensor2lidar_translation (3,): lidar2cam_r = inv(s2l_rot); lidar2cam_t = s2l_trans @ lidar2cam_r.T; lidar2cam_rt = eye4 with [:3,:3]=lidar2cam_r.T and [3,:3]=-lidar2cam_t; viewpad=eye4 with intrinsic; lidar2img = viewpad @ lidar2cam_rt.T. They do NOT consume a raw 4x4 extrinsic. GaussianLSS by contrast (transforms.py:176, get_cameras) computes lidar2img = viewpad(I) @ extrinsic directly, so the GaussianLSS 'extrinsics' 4x4 IS lidar2cam (specifically cam_from_egolidarflat, see nuscenes_dataset.py:151 E = cam_from_egocam @ egocam_from_world @ world_from_egolidarflat). Therefore: GaussianLSS extrinsic == lidar2cam == inv(sensor2lidar_4x4). Mapping: sensor2lidar_4x4 = inv(extrinsic); s2l_rot = sensor2lidar_4x4[:3,:3]; s2l_trans = sensor2lidar_4x4[:3,3].

(2) CARLA FRAME. From sedan_infos_val.pkl: lidar2ego = identity rot + (0,0,1.8); ego/lidar frame is +X forward, +Y left, +Z up (CAM_FRONT s2l_t=[0.6,0,-0.2], CAM_BACK=[-1,0,-0.2], CAM_FRONT_LEFT=[0.4,0.4,-0.2]). Native image 1600x900 (cx=800,cy=450). Main-repo gt_boxes are mmdet3d LiDAR boxes (x,y,z,w,l,h,yaw), x/y in meters spanning beyond +-50m.

(3) BEV ALIGNMENT — they are NOT aligned; a fixed rotate+transpose is required. BEVFormer point_sampling (encoder.py:89-149) + get_reference_points (encoder.py:64-67): ref_x (W/col index) -> lidarX over pc_range[0..3]; ref_y (H/row index) -> lidarY over pc_range[1..4], both INCREASING. So in BEVFormer BEV grid: col(w_idx)=lidarX, row(h_idx)=lidarY. GaussianLSS view matrix (common.py:23-30, h=w=200,100m,offset0 => sh=sw=2): px_col=-2*Y+100, px_row=-2*X+100, applied as (V@points)[:2] in transforms.py:301-302. So in the GaussianLSS mask: row=lidarX (DECREASING), col=lidarY (DECREASING). Net: 90deg rotation + reflection between the two. Verified numerically: front(+10X) lands at GaussianLSS (row80,col100) but BEVFormer (row100,col120). The transform that maps a GaussianLSS 200x200 mask into BEVFormer (bev_h=h_idx, bev_w=w_idx) layout: mask_bev = np.flip(mask_g.T) == np.rot90(mask_g,2).T == index map mask_bev[r,c]=mask_g[N-1-c, N-1-r] (all three verified equal).

(4) RECOMMENDED PATH (lowest risk): do NOT introduce GaussianLSS jsons. Reuse the existing data/nuscenes symlink + existing {vehicle}_infos_{train,val}.pkl (nuScenes-DB format, already produce correct lidar2img). Subclass CarlaNuScenesDataset, add a pipeline transform that rasterizes a 200x200 vehicle mask DIRECTLY from the lidar-frame gt_boxes already in img_metas, using a BEVFormer-aligned view matrix (col=lidarX, row=lidarY). This sidesteps the rotation entirely, keeps lidar2img untouched, and only needs an image-size/scale change (1600x900 @ 0.3 -> 224x480) and bev_h/bev_w=200, pc_range +-50. Writing a fresh Dataset reading GaussianLSS jsons is higher risk (must re-derive sensor2lidar from extrinsic, must apply the flip-transpose to every mask, must re-map yaw).

gotchas: BEV layouts are NOT trivially aligned: GaussianLSS mask has row=lidarX(decreasing), col=lidarY(decreasing); BEVFormer grid has row=lidarY(increasing), col=lidarX(increasing). A raw GaussianLSS mask fed as GT will be rotated 90deg+mirrored vs BEVFormer's BEV. Use mask_bev=np.flip(mask_g.T) OR render fresh from lidar boxes (recommended).

GaussianLSS 'extrinsics' is lidar2cam (cam_from_egolidarflat), NOT cam2ego/sensor2lidar. sensor2lidar = inv(extrinsic). Feeding extrinsic where get_data_info expects sensor2lidar (or vice-versa) silently produces a wrong but plausible projection.

GaussianLSS uses egolidarFLAT pose (yaw-only, zero pitch/roll, common.py:42-44 get_pose flat=True); CARLA lidar2ego rotation is identity anyway so flat==full here, but do not assume this for tilted-cam (VP) experiments.

GaussianLSS remaps box yaw as yaw=-yaw-pi/2 (transforms.py:289) and swaps size to l,w (nuscenes_dataset.py:219 stores l,w not w,l). If you reuse the GaussianLSS rasterizer verbatim on main-repo lidar boxes you will double-apply / mis-apply this. Rendering from mmdet3d LiDARInstance3DBoxes.corners avoids it.

pc_range mismatch: existing carla config uses +-51.2 with bev 50x50 (0.5 m/cell anyway). For GaussianLSS-matched GT use +-50 (0.5 m/cell at 200) so the mask and query grid share the same 0.5m resolution; mixing 51.2 vs 50 introduces a 1.024x scale error in the mask.

Image size: GaussianLSS does resize-then-top_crop(46) to 224x480 (transforms.py:157-170) and bakes crop into intrinsic (I[1,2]-=top_crop). BEVFormer's RandomScaleImageMultiViewImage scales intrinsics for you but does NOT crop; replicate the crop in intrinsic or skip it but then update cy and img_shape consistently, else point_sampling u/v normalization (encoder.py:130-131) is off.

BEV feature flatten order: bev_query is (H*W) with W contiguous (encoder.py:69 flatten after permute). When reshaping to a 2D map for seg loss use .view(bs,H,W,C) then permute; a wrong (W,H) reshape transposes the prediction relative to the GT mask.
class index 5 == pedestrian in GaussianLSS DYNAMIC list; vehicle-occupancy must exclude it. Main-repo gt_names also contain 'pedestrian' — filter by class_names, not just non-empty boxes.

data/nuscenes symlink points at carla_geobev; image data_path inside infos is 'data/nuscenes/sweeps/...'. The seg loader strips on 'nuscenes/' (loading.py:171) — main BEVFormer loader uses data_path as-is, so keep paths relative to data_root.
